name: Meatballs
description: Beef and Italian sausage meatballs made with mashed potato instead of bread crumbs, baked or pan-fried and served in sauce over noodles. Optionally stuffed with mozzarella.
keywords: meatballs, Italian sausage, mashed potato, stuffed meatballs
recipeIngredient: 1 to 2 lb ground beef (usually 1 1/2 lb hamburger plus 1 lb bulk sweet Italian sausage)
Mozzarella brick or string cheese, cubed and frozen (optional, for stuffing)
Your favorite sauce and noodles, to serve

recipeInstructions.name: Make the mashed potato
recipeInstructions.text: Bake 1 potato (microwave works), let it cool a few minutes, then peel and mash with 2/3 cup milk using a fork.

recipeInstructions.name: Add seasonings
recipeInstructions.text: Add 1 egg, 1/4 cup parmesan, 2 teaspoons Kosher salt, 1 Tbsp chopped fresh parsley, 2 teaspoons black pepper, 1 teaspoon dried oregano or marjoram, and 2 to 3 minced garlic cloves to the mashed potato and mix until well combined.

recipeInstructions.name: Add the meat and form
recipeInstructions.text: Add the ground meat and combine well. Form into meatballs, wrapping each around a cube of cheese if making stuffed meatballs.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook
recipeInstructions.text: Pan fry in olive oil, or bake at 350°F on a cooling rack set over a 13x9 pan to catch drippings, until no longer pink, about 15 minutes for 1-inch meatballs. If stuffed, gently turn halfway through cooking.

recipeInstructions.name: Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Toss with your favorite sauce and serve over noodles.
Fresh parsley and fresh garlic work best here.
Stuffing with cheese: cut mozzarella into cubes and freeze them before you start the meat mixture. Frozen cheese oozes out less as the meatballs cook.
Forming: the meat mixture is easier to shape if your hands are not hot, so rinse them under cold water before forming meatballs.
The mashed potato replaces bread crumbs.
